questions.question: The values of Stock [latex]\text{A}[/latex] and Stock [latex]\text{B}[/latex] on a particular day are Rs. [latex]50[/latex] and Rs. [latex]80[/latex], respectively. An investor invests Rs. [latex]100[/latex] in Stock [latex]\text{A}[/latex] and Rs. [latex]80[/latex] in Stock [latex]\text{B}[/latex]. He sells all the stocks the next day when the value of Stock [latex]\text{A}[/latex] is Rs. [latex]55[/latex] and Stock [latex]\text{B}[/latex] is Rs. [latex]70[/latex]. The profit made by the investor is Rs. ________
questions.explanation:
Stock A: Rs. [latex]100[/latex] invested at Rs. [latex]50[/latex]/share buys [latex]100/50=2[/latex] shares. Sold next day at Rs. [latex]55[/latex]/share: [latex]2\times55=110[/latex]. Profit [latex]=110-100=10[/latex].

Stock B: Rs. [latex]80[/latex] invested at Rs. [latex]80[/latex]/share buys [latex]80/80=1[/latex] share. Sold next day at Rs. [latex]70[/latex]/share: [latex]1\times70=70[/latex]. Profit [latex]=70-80=-10[/latex] (a loss).

Total profit [latex]=10+(-10)=0[/latex].

Answer: 0

questions.question:
The paper as shown in the figure is folded to make a cube where each square corresponds to a particular face of the cube. Which one of the following options correctly represents the cube?
Note: The figures shown are representative.
questions.explanation:
Label the net's center square (holding the hollow triangle [latex]\triangle[/latex]) as the cube's front face. When a plus-shaped net folds into a cube, each square adjacent to the center folds directly onto the corresponding adjacent cube face:

- The square directly above center (holding the filled dot [latex]\bullet[/latex]) becomes the top face.
- The square directly below center (holding the hollow circle [latex]\circ[/latex]) becomes the bottom face.
- The square to the right of center (holding the filled triangle [latex]\blacktriangle[/latex]) becomes the right face.
- The square to the left of center (blank) becomes the left face.

So on the folded cube: front = [latex]\triangle[/latex], top = [latex]\bullet[/latex], right = [latex]\blacktriangle[/latex], bottom = [latex]\circ[/latex], left = blank.

Checking the candidate cubes (each drawn showing the front face with [latex]\triangle[/latex] and one other visible face): the cube where the dot appears on the top face alongside the triangle on the front — exactly matching the derived front/top relationship — is option A. The other options place a different symbol (or the same symbol in the wrong position/face) adjacent to the front triangle, which contradicts the adjacency established directly from the net.

Answer: A

questions.question: The average marks obtained by a class in an examination were calculated as 30.8. However, while checking the marks entered, the teacher found that the marks of one student were entered incorrectly as 24 instead of 42. After correcting the marks, the average becomes 31.4. How many students does the class have?
questions.explanation:
Let the class have [latex]n[/latex] students. The total marks initially (with the error) [latex]=30.8n[/latex]. Correcting one student's mark from [latex]24[/latex] to [latex]42[/latex] adds [latex]42-24=18[/latex] to the total:

[latex]30.8n+18=31.4n\ \Rightarrow\ 18=0.6n\ \Rightarrow\ n=30[/latex]

Answer: 30

questions.question:
Based on the given statements, select the most appropriate option to solve the given question.

If two floors in a certain building are 9 feet apart, how many steps are there in a set of stairs that extends from the first floor to the second floor of the building?

Statements:

I. Each step is 3/4 foot high.
II. Each step is 1 foot wide.

options.A: Statements I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not sufficient.
options.B: Statements II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not sufficient.
options.C: Both statements together are sufficient, but neither statement alone is sufficient.
options.D: Statements I and II together are not sufficient.?

questions.explanation:
Number of steps = height / step height = 9 / (3/4) = 12, so statement I alone answers it.

The width of a step does not tell how many steps there are.

Answer: Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not

options.B: Participating students should come at 9.00 a.m. accompanied by a parent, and other parents and students should come by 10.00 a.m.

questions.question: An unbiased six-faced dice whose faces are marked with numbers [latex]1,2,3,4,5[/latex], and [latex]6[/latex] is rolled twice in succession and the number on the top face is recorded each time. The probability that the sum of the two recorded numbers is a prime number is ________
questions.explanation:
Out of the [latex]36[/latex] equally likely outcomes of rolling two dice, count how many give a prime sum (possible sums range from [latex]2[/latex] to [latex]12[/latex]; the primes in this range are [latex]2,3,5,7,11[/latex]):

[latex]\begin{array}{c|c}\text{Sum}&\text{Number of ways}\\\hline2&1\\3&2\\5&4\\7&6\\11&2\end{array}[/latex]

Total favorable outcomes [latex]=1+2+4+6+2=15[/latex].

Probability [latex]=\dfrac{15}{36}[/latex].

Answer: 15/36

In the 4 x 4 array shown below, each cell of the first three rows has either a cross (X) or a number.

questions.question: Consider the equation: [latex](7526)_8 - (Y)_8=(4364)_8[/latex], where [latex](X)_N[/latex] stands for [latex]X[/latex] to the base [latex]N[/latex]. Find [latex]Y[/latex].

questions.question:
A cube is to be cut into 8 pieces of equal size and shape. Here, each cut should be straight and it should not stop till it reaches the other end of the cube.
The minimum number of such cuts required is

Two straight cuts can give at most 4 such equal pieces, so 3 is the minimum.

questions.question:
The country of Zombieland is in distress since more than 75% of its working population is suffering from serious health issues. Studies conducted by competent health experts concluded that a complete lack of physical exercise among its working population was one of the leading causes of their health issues. As one of the measures to address the problem, the Government of Zombieland has decided to provide monetary incentives to those who ride bicycles to work.
Based only on the information provided above, which one of the following statements can be logically inferred with certainty?

options.A: All the working population of Zombieland will henceforth ride bicycles to work.
options.B:
Riding bicycles will ensure that all of the working population of Zombieland is free
of health issues.
options.C:
The health experts suggested to the Government of Zombieland to declare riding
bicycles as mandatory.
options.D:
The Government of Zombieland believes that riding bicycles is a form of physical
exercise.

questions.explanation:
The government gives incentives for cycling because lack of exercise is a cause of the health issues. This only makes sense if it believes cycling is a form of physical exercise.

The other options claim things the passage does not support (everyone will cycle, all will be healthy, experts asked for it to be mandatory).

Answer: The Government of Zombieland believes that riding bicycles is a form of physical exercise

questions.question: In the figure below, [latex]\angle DEC + \angle BFC[/latex] is equal to _____

Let [latex]a=\angle BAD[/latex], [latex]e=\angle DEC[/latex], [latex]f=\angle BFC[/latex]. In quadrilateral ABCD:
- [latex]\angle ABC=180^\circ-a-e[/latex] (from triangle AEB)
- [latex]\angle ADC=180^\circ-a-f[/latex] (from triangle ADF)
- [latex]\angle BCD=360^\circ-a-(180^\circ-a-e)-(180^\circ-a-f)=a+e+f[/latex]

So [latex]e+f=\angle BCD-\angle BAD[/latex].

Answer: [latex]\angle BCD-\angle BAD[/latex]

questions.question: Given digits 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4 how many distinct 4 digit numbers greater than 3000 can be formed?

- First 4: remaining 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4. All 27 except 222 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 26

Total = 25 + 26 = 51

Answer: 51
